notes: pageOffset: PDF page index = book page + 1. All 39 app page numbers match the book.
Most updates fill in Target/Area/Effect lines, which the app data lacked for every spell in this book.
Spiritwall: the book prints no Range line (stat block goes Casting Time -> Effect). The app has "Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)"; left unchanged, flagged for review.
Ghostform: the stat block says Sorcerer/wizard 8 (app matches), but the chapter spell list puts it under 7th level. Kept 8.

Resist Energy, Mass prints Components V, S, DF (app matches). Summon Elemental Monolith prints V, S, M/DF (app has M, matching the rule). Summon Elemental Monolith descriptor is printed as [see text].

Repair Minor/Moderate/Serious/Critical Damage, Sign of Sealing, Greater, Stony Grasp and Sword of Darkness are "functions like" spells; only printed lines were compared. Sign of Sealing, Greater prints no school line.
Transmute Rock to Lava: descriptors printed in order [Earth, Fire].

No additions. Every other Sor/Wiz spell in the chapter list is already in the app under another book (mostly Spell Compendium), sometimes with a different name: Burning Blood -> "Burning Blood, Foe's" (the app's "Burning Blood" is a different Draconomicon spell), Assay Resistance -> "Assay Spell Resistance", Superior Invisibility -> "Invisibility, Superior", Leomund's Hidden Lodge -> "Hidden Lodge", Otiluke's (Greater) Dispelling Screen -> "Dispelling Screen(, Greater)". Several of these differ in level between Complete Arcane and the app (e.g. Discern Shapechanger 3 vs 2, Aiming at the Target 5 vs 2, Arrow of Bone 6 vs 7, Fiendform 6 vs 5, Freezing Fog 5 vs 6, Anticipate Teleportation 4 vs 3, Fortify Familiar 4 vs 3, Familiar Pocket 2 vs 1, Blades of Fire 2 vs 1); left alone because they are listed under Spell Compendium.
